summary: ## Verdict **Critical XSS regression** — this change must not merge as written. ## What went wrong `Comment` previously ran `body` through `escapeHtml` before `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, which made the DOM path safe (plain text only). The PR deletes that escaping and feeds `body` straight into `__html`. Any caller that passes user- or third-party-controlled comment text (typical for a `Comment` component) can inject arbitrary HTML/JS: `

verification.reason: The patch removes escapeHtml and passes the body string straight into dangerouslySetInnerHTML, so untrusted comment HTML executes in-page with no sanitizer or markdown path added. That is a real XSS regression; critical severity is appropriate.
